title: Lisbon · Sintra Ridge and Atlantic Coast
slogan: Ridge roads, ocean wind and a palace-town pause.
story: Ridge roads, ocean wind and a palace-town pause. 96 km round from Sintra - plan on about 1 h 40 of riding. It goes by way of Cabo da Roca, Guincho coast and Cascais. The coast is the point of it.
